comment: Two alternative PCB daughterboards for a 3PDT bypass footswitch, each drawn as a parts view and an etch mask: the first carries a MAX1044 charge pump giving -9v, the second only the LED and its resistor. The first (charge pump) board is read; the second would be just a 2.2K resistor and the LED. Not an effect circuit.
